description: This file defines a web page class 'SetExam' for managing multiple-choice questions and exams in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for navigation, course selection, question addition, and exam setup, with database interactions for storing questions and exam details.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the web page for setting up exams and questions in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; currently commented out code for session-based question number.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database, updates question number, and shows alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up an exam for the selected course, inserts exam record into database, and redirects.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to LoginPage.aspx for user logout.
